TranslationContext: This file contains Unit Names for the Goatmen Raiders Faction.

Translations.Comment: 山羊人 = goat-man/goat-beast-men. 略奪者 = raider. Fierce tribal warriors.
アイベックス = ibex (mountain goat). Fierce and aggressive warriors.
戦士 = warrior. Savage and brutal goat-man infantry.
雑種 = mongrel/mixed breed, 群れ = pack/horde. Chaotic mass of lesser beasts.
槍兵 = spear warrior. Mongrel troops wielding crude spears.
戦車 = chariot. Fast attack vehicle for raids.
野獣 = feral/wild beast, 猛犬 = fierce hound. Savage war beasts.
軽兵 = skirmisher/light troops. Harassment units.
ケンタウロス = centaur (katakana). Half-man, half-horse beast.
ミノタウロス = minotaur (katakana). Bull-headed warrior beast.
ハルピュイア = harpies (katakana). Flying creatures allied with beast-men.
野獣 = feral/wild. Untamed giant serving beast-men forces.
シャーマン = shaman. Tribal magic user wielding dark rituals.
ロングホーン = longhorn. Elite warrior with impressive curved horns.
領主 = lord/ruler. Mighty minotaur commander and hero.
